qdw-forge.role: capability registry, leases and invocation execution exchange

qdw-sandbox.role: incubator/donor for Estate, LifeGit, human, data-rights and experimental policies

findings.title: Estate duplicates QDW final routing/verification authority
findings.resolution: Sandbox remains incubator; graduate policy math/contracts, disable EstateRouter/EstateVerificationService as production authorities.

findings.title: Forge verification trusts caller-authored passed boolean
findings.resolution: VerificationCertificateRef + resolver bound to invocation/output; no passed boolean.

findings.title: Dell recommendation would create dual final-route truth if consumed literally
findings.resolution: Dell emits ADVISORY candidate snapshot; QDW HotSwap remains final route.

findings.title: Unknown output token price is currently coerced to zero in workload cost
findings.resolution: If output tokens > 0 and output price is unknown, total cost is unknown; frozen regression included.

findings.title: GitGoblin exporter targets legacy VentureLab/Cuntgoblin schema
findings.resolution: Versioned QDW ObservationBatch and OpportunityProposal exporter.

findings.title: Current QDW Route pricing cannot represent Forge per-call assets without fabrication
findings.resolution: Generalize Route with fixed_request_cost_usd and persist it.

findings.title: External outage can be confused with a legitimate zero-candidate result
findings.resolution: Shared ExternalStatus; UNAVAILABLE/STALE/OK_EMPTY are distinct and contract-tested.

findings.title: Forge asset posterior and QDW task posterior represent different populations
findings.resolution: Forge profile may seed a sourced prior feature only; QDW maintains independent task-cell posterior.

findings.title: Moving repository heads would make certified federation non-reproducible
findings.resolution: Pin exact SHAs; automated pin upgrades require protocol diff + full suite.

reference_experiment.flow: GitGoblin observation -> Dell advisory -> QDW final choice -> Forge pinned invocation -> QDW certificate
reference_experiment.native_git_clone: blocked by container DNS; exact source inspected via GitHub connector
